title: Meta Muse Code Contributor Tier: 20x Off, One Catch | swarmz.net

facts.fact: Meta introduced Muse Code, a terminal coding agent, and the Muse Spark 1.2 model behind it on 5 August 2026.
facts.quote: Meta introduced Muse Code, a terminal coding agent, and the Muse Spark 1.2 model behind it on 5 August 2026.

facts.fact: Per Meta's research blog, Muse Code is a terminal coding agent in beta that plans, writes and validates changes across large repositories.
facts.quote: Muse Code is a terminal coding agent in beta that plans, writes and validates changes across large repositories

facts.fact: Engadget and MacRumors both report that Muse Code's availability at launch covers macOS and Linux.
facts.quote: both put availability at macOS and Linux at launch.

facts.fact: Reporting across outlets (not a vendor price sheet) puts standard API pricing for Muse Spark at roughly $1.25 per million input tokens.
facts.quote: standard API pricing at roughly $1.25 per million input tokens and $4.25 per million output tokens

facts.fact: Reporting across outlets puts the Meta Muse Code Contributor tier at around $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: with the Contributor tier around $0.10 input and $0.20 output

facts.fact: The page states the Contributor tier is roughly 12x cheaper than standard on input and roughly 20x cheaper on output.
facts.quote: That is a discount of roughly 12x on input and 20x on output.

facts.fact: The Contributor tier is described as carrying materially lower rate limits than standard, though no specific limits are given.
facts.quote: The Contributor tier is also described as carrying materially lower rate limits than standard.

facts.fact: The Contributor discount is paid for with users' prompts and completions, which Meta may use to train future models.
facts.quote: the discount is paid for with your prompts and completions, which Meta may use to train future models.
